title: the charge usage cache
notes: The cache is `kernel.UsageCache`, encoded into the installation's `port.Cache`, in process or on Redis or Valkey (architecture §8); `fees.Service` reads and fills it per charge bucket (libs/billing/fees/usage_cache.go), validating each entry against the store's ingestion watermark (`metering.Watermark`).

reasons.hook: A hook for other cache services: the charge cache keeps every computed value (lago ChargeCacheService does not override `cacheable?`); Tanvo has no other cache service.
reasons.untracked: Every Tanvo cache entry carries its watermark; there is no cache service without lazy validation.
reasons.legacy: Entry shapes of the shared Rails cache from before lazy validation; Tanvo's cache only ever holds encoded `kernel.UsageCacheEntry` values, and one it cannot decode is a miss.
reasons.expire: Explicit expiry is for event deletion and duplicate cleanup, which change usage without advancing the watermark: lago no longer deletes events when a metric is destroyed (docs/parity.md, deprecated features), and the event stores deduplicate at ingestion, so no Tanvo path removes events the cache aggregated. A replacement or re-enrichment advances the watermark (`written_at` in PostgreSQL, `enriched_at` in ClickHouse).
reasons.go-types: An interface method cannot be left unimplemented in Go.
reasons.key-segments: `usageCacheKey` appends the full-usage segment after the filter segments independently of them; the filter segment is ported at charge_cache_service_spec.rb:21 and the full-usage one at :30.
